rule:
- Section 8 (one skewer opens into a spectrum), "the shown spectrum": among the retrieved
  candidates, keep those that (i) lie in the fan slab, so the skewer that opens is that quasar's
  own; (ii) are BAL-free in zlya (BI_CIV = AI_CIV = 0); (iii) have no absorber with
  log N_HI >= 20.3 passing the recommended cuts of either DR1 DLA VAC (Toolkit v2.0:
  SNR_REDSIDE > 2, NHI > 20.3, DELTACHI2 > 0.3; CNN+GP: ABSORBER_TYPE == 'DLA',
  CNN_DLA_CONFIDENCE > 0.2 (S2N > 3) or > 0.3 (S2N <= 3), GP_DLA_CONFIDENCE > 0.9); (iv) are a
  forest of the DR1 Lya BAO (present in delta-lya-0-0); then take the highest forest S/N.
- Section 10 (find), "the DLA example": among the candidates with at least one DLA passing both
  VACs' cuts, the one with the fewest such DLAs, then the highest forest S/N; the next one is
  the second example (the double DLA).
